name: p5-buddy-bundled
description: DEPLOY BUNDLE manifest for the buddy worker — copied to deploy/<app>/buddy/package.json by deploy-city-apps.sh. `type:commonjs` lets server/*.js (ESM via their own server/package.json) import named exports from logic/*.js; the deps here serve the Cloudflare Worker build (wrangler resolves ai/@ai-sdk/zod from this node_modules). Kept in sync with server/package.json. Secrets (.env) and node_modules are excluded from the bundle by the deploy script.
